no-restricted-syntax.message: Hand-written fetch is banned outside src/utils/api.ts (ADR-0001 §4). Use the generated client from '@/utils/api' so a contract change breaks the build rather than a user's session. WebSocket traffic is plane 2 and uses `new WebSocket`, which this rule does not match; the one legitimate raw fetch (the S3 presigned upload, which is not a gateway path) lives in api.ts and is exempted below.

Raw hex colour is banned outside the two definition sites (ADR-0013). Colour is defined once in src/app/globals.css :root and src/utils/theme.ts, and referenced everywhere else: var(--color-*) in CSS/styled-jsx, BARROW/BARROW_HEX in TS. A new colour is a token in BOTH files first, then referenced. This covers inline style={{}} objects and third-party theme configs (Stripe Elements) too, which no CSS-only rule would reach.
Raw hex colour is banned outside the two definition sites (ADR-0013) — including inside template literals and styled-jsx blocks. Use var(--color-*) or BARROW.*.
Hand-written fetch is banned outside src/utils/api.ts (ADR-0001 section 4).
